target_customer: Architecture and engineering firms that review drawing sets before they go to contractors
problem: Drawing packages run to thousands of sheets and manual review misses errors that return later as RFIs, change orders and field rework.
product_category: AI QA and QC for construction drawings and Revit models

founders.name: Raymond Zhao
education: University of Oxford, maths and statistics
founders.background_notes: Implemented an AI system at a VC firm per the YC page.

founders.name: Issy Greenslade
education: University of Oxford, economics and management
founders.background_notes: Director of Oxford's VC Fund per the YC page.

founders.name: Brandon Abreu Smith
founders.background_notes: First author of a NeurIPS paper per the YC page.

competitors.name: Bluebeam (acquired Firmus AI)
competitors.what: Drawing markup incumbent that bought Firmus AI for AI drawing review features

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading thousands of drawing sheets and native Revit models, applying codes and linking findings across disciplines is hard AI and data work.

defensibility.rationale: Firm specific standards and audit trails add lock in, but several startups and Bluebeam target the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Bluebeam bought Firmus AI in September 2025 and later launched AI review inside Bluebeam Max. Competing startups such as Buildcheck also raised funding.

market_need_then: Drawing errors cause rework and change orders, and incumbents moving to acquire drawing review AI in 2025 shows demand.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic name that overlaps with other companies named Structured, with no found brand press.

outcome_analysis: Structured AI is active. Its Oxford founders raised a reported $4.2M seed led by FCVC in June 2026, a few months after the YC batch, with a strategic tie to engineering firm Syska Hennessy. It faces an incumbent that bought AI drawing review technology and other funded startups.
notes: ENR article date is taken from the YC page (June 9, 2026), and a PropTech Connect article cross-checks the round and investors (shared 2026-06-23).
